annotations.title: Look up one Irish car listing by id

description: Use when you already have a listing id (from another call or a dealer site) and want that single vehicle: make, model, year, price, mileage, status and days on market, how its price compares with the market median, and an indicative VRT breakdown. Returns one row. For ranked below-market deals across all stock use get_irish_auto_arbitrage_feed. Use analyze_listing instead when you want closest comparables and price history. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

listing_id.description: The listing id as returned by other tools, e.g. a Carzone ad id or a dealer stock id.

source_platform.description: Optional source platform. Only needed when the same id exists on more than one source.
